description: HTTP framework for V with its own HTTP/1.1 engine: one SO_REUSEPORT epoll worker per CPU, pipelined responses batched into one write, and no allocation per request inside the framework (CI-enforced). Router with :params, middleware chain (c.next()), compile-time JSON encoder, gzip middleware on its own DEFLATE encoder. TLS 1.3 on the same epoll workers through mbedtls, the TLS library V ships, with certificates reloaded when the files change. Request framing is smuggling-hardened (Content-Length and chunked) and fuzzed in CI. Default configuration.
